# Data.Char

<!-- Generated by `prism docs` from `lib/std/Data/Char.pr`. Do not edit by hand. -->

ASCII character classification.

Operates on the byte/codepoint returned by `byte_at`/`char_at`. Base includes this module.

## Functions and Values

### `is_digit`

```prism,sig,h-32e6d43f466a22b1ae6cb893e8e96842226ac80a073810c64c0b17461dfd57c2
is_digit : (Int) -> Bool
```

True for an ASCII decimal digit (`0`-`9`).

```prism,mod=Data.Char
is_digit(char_at("7", 0))
```

```output
true
```

### `to_lower_c`

